LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.0.label: Aid Rhythm
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.0.descriptio: Requires Aid Pulse learned from its augment card. Retains original healing, shielding, range and cooldown. Later nodes require actual recoverable injury healing by this skill; its original shield on a healthy target does not trigger them.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.1.label: Medic’s Barrier
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.1.descriptio: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. Existing healing and shielding modifiers still apply. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.2.label: Continued Care
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.2.descriptio: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, heal 20 base injury points on the most injured other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight, once per 8 seconds. This may be the original patient if still injured; it never selects you. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.3.label: Medic’s Reprisal
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.3.descriptio: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, store one reprisal for 5 seconds, at most one, once per 8 seconds. Your later ordinary hit consumes it for 50 bonus damage; secondary damage cannot retrigger it. Base rewards: damage 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.4.label: Shared Protection
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.4.descriptio: After Aid Pulse actually heals an injury, shield the nearest other eligible colonist within 4 cells of you and clear sight for 50 base points over 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. With no eligible ally it does not shield you instead. Base rewards: shield 50.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.5.label: Mutual Recovery
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.5.descriptio: After Continued Care actually heals another colonist, heal 20 base points of your own recoverable injuries, once per 8 seconds. Without an injured follow-up patient or actual additional healing, nothing triggers. Base rewards: healing 20.
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.6.label: Caregiver’s Guard
LanguageData.RHA_STAR_Skill_Aid015.nodes.6.descriptio: After Continued Care actually heals another colonist, gain a separate 2-base-point shield for 3 seconds, once per 8 seconds. The primary skill’s healing alone is not enough. Base rewards: shield 50.
